summary: Frontend-only smoke + integration testing for Free Way Scuba Diving marketing site. All 10 requested features verified across desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (390x844). No backend testing requested. All tests passed with zero console errors.

issues: Hero H1 white text can be slightly low-contrast over the lighter regions of the background image on small viewports; consider stronger gradient overlay. Minor / not blocking.

verified_features: Navigation: all 7 nav links (home/tours/courses/destinations/reviews/faq/contact) route correctly and render content.
lang-toggle-btn switches EN<->ES; Spanish content (e.g. 'Reservar por WhatsApp', 'Buceo') verified; language PERSISTS across client-side navigation (Home -> Tours retains ES).
hero-whatsapp-btn href = https://wa.me/529841361212?text=Hi%20Free%20Way%20Scuba... (prefilled text query param present).
tour-book-btn-0..5 all anchors with href starting https://wa.me/529841361212 and include encoded tour name (e.g. 'Diving%20in%20Playa%20del%20Carmen').
course-book-btn-0..4 all anchors with href starting https://wa.me/529841361212.
faq-item-0..8 present; click expands (data-state=open) via Radix Accordion.
contact-whatsapp-btn href -> wa.me/529841361212; contact-email-btn href = mailto:freewayscuba@gmail.com.
floating-whatsapp-btn present on every tested page (/, /tours, /courses, /faq, /contact, /destinations, /reviews) with correct wa.me href.
Mobile (390px): mobile-menu-toggle opens mobile-menu containing all 7 nav links + mobile-whatsapp-btn (wa.me).
Zero console errors / page errors across all routes.
critical_code_review_comments: LanguageContext does not persist `lang` to localStorage/sessionStorage. State survives client-side navigation (provider sits above BrowserRouter) but resets to 'en' on full page reload. Not a tested requirement but a UX gap worth fixing for a marketing site where users may share/bookmark deep links.

Mobile viewport (<sm) has no visible desktop lang-toggle-btn; only mobile-lang-toggle inside the burger menu. Functionally fine; the spec specifically named lang-toggle-btn which is desktop-only - acceptable.
All WhatsApp anchors correctly use target=_blank rel=noopener noreferrer.
All images sourced from Unsplash/Pexels render successfully; relevant to diving theme.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend-only site. Public URL https://dive-riviera.preview.emergentagent.com. All interactive elements have data-testid. WhatsApp number 529841361212. No backend / no API calls. waLink() helper in /app/frontend/src/data/content.js builds WA URLs. LanguageContext lacks localStorage persistence (state-only).
